followUpQuestions: How do ANVIL Platform, Smithy, Vulcan and Offline Speech Translation relate, and which configurations are orderable now?
Which classification environments, accreditation controls, data-residency options and deployment topologies are independently verified for each configuration?
Which exact APIs, data models, open standards or STANAGs were tested, in which exercise configurations, and with what published results?
Which current products map to the three disclosed defence contracts, and what test, delivery or operational outcomes can be shared for each?
reviewWarnings: No reviewed source establishes whether ANVIL Platform, Smithy, Offline Speech Translation and Vulcan are modules, releases or separate products.
ANVIL's claims of operational deployment and interoperability testing with every NATO ally plus Ukraine remain vendor-origin; no allied-government test, contract or deployment source was recovered.
Pathway to Commercialization eligibility supports successful testing and market readiness but does not establish a call-up, sale, user, deployment or adoption.
Vulcan is Available for testing, which is a pre-test status and not a match, contract, completed evaluation, performance result or adoption.
The three disclosed defence contracts do not identify a current product, named end user, completed test result or operational deployment.
The SLSA and SBIPS instruments show CAD 0 and support supplier eligibility only, not revenue, buyer demand, call-ups or customer use.
Federal lobbying records prove contract pursuit and communication, not government interest, demand, influence, award, deployment or endorsement.
Corporations Canada discloses only one 25% to 50% significant-control interest; the remaining cap table and full Canadian ownership are unresolved.
The speech-translation record is a published patent application family and the ANVIL mark is advertised for opposition; neither supports a granted-patent or registered-trademark claim.
No public source resolved product accreditation, classification approval, Controlled Goods status, exact security-control mapping or mission-data residency.
No public source discloses ANVIL's exact API protocols, named STANAGs, hardware envelope, pricing, standard configurations, production capacity or delivery lead time.
The privacy policy's U.S. processing statement concerns covered personal information and must not be converted into a claim about classified or mission-data hosting.
The planned Project Convergence evaluation has no recovered public completion report, configuration, measured result or adoption decision.
The Cameroon vendor-country value in one Open Government contract row conflicts with ANVIL's Canadian corporate identity and Ottawa address and is excluded as a disclosure anomaly.
Current headcount is unresolved: dated federal supplier records and company-reported 2026 figures are not an independently audited workforce count.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed ANVIL's current Canadian defence-software identity, public inquiry path and platform-led product presentation.
Resolved ANVIL Platform ingestion, ontology, AI, API, graph, access-control and disconnected-edge functions but found no protocol, benchmark or accreditation document.
Confirmed active federal corporation 986012-6, bilingual current name, predecessor names, Ottawa office and the bounded 25-to-50-percent significant-control disclosure.
Resolved one published speech-translation patent application family and one pending ANVIL trademark, but no granted patent, registered mark or second product-specific patent family.
Resolved three non-overlapping defence contracts and two current zero-dollar supplier arrangements without finding a safe contract-to-product or operational-outcome crosswalk.
Resolved Smithy and Offline Speech Translation as current Pathway innovations and Vulcan as separately Available for testing, preserving their different maturity boundaries.
Resolved current AI Armoury and AI-Forge contribution records while keeping agreement ceilings separate from disbursement, revenue, procurement and equity financing.
Resolved active 2026 federal contract-pursuit communications for ANVIL and Smithy without treating outreach as government demand, award, adoption or endorsement.

Allied and customer searches produced zero qualifying NATO, DIANA, NCIA, NSPA, UK, US or Australian contract, trial or deployment records; the Army article added only bounded Canadian use and planned-evaluation context.
Final security, certification, Controlled Goods, financing and deployment probes produced zero new qualifying evidence; public-list absence was retained as unknown rather than negative.
